selection: Minimum pooled log loss in the three seasons preceding each target year. Each inner fold trains only through its previous year. Refit chosen logistic coefficients through targetYear-1. The fixed scoring anchor has shrinkage 5, home 3, decay .94, scale 8.
scope: All evaluations are retrospective. No future results enter a target week, but historical source revisions and developer exposure preclude pristine prospective-test claims.
